questions.question: C1 — how should the operator gate on Claude Code be made honest?

options.label: Transcript-verified (Recommended)
options.description: `resolve` on an operator gate checks the session transcript for an AskUserQuestion answer after the gate blocked; without one, clearing requires an explicit `--no-questions --reason "…"`. The matrix row stays `enforced`, which is then actually true.

options.label: Downgrade to advisory
options.description: Mark claude-code `advisory` so the loud STOP notice prints on every harness. Smallest change; still no mechanical check.

options.label: Both
options.description: Degrade loudly now AND add transcript verification: the notice until verification ships, then flip back to enforced.

questions.question: C6/C7 — how should a step prove its named skill's work happened, not just that an entry exists?

options.label: Separate-context review (Recommended)
options.description: review-phase must be done by a dispatched reviewer subagent; evidence = its agent id, checked against the cursor. deliver requires `--evidence tests=<log>` of a suite run by the orchestrator. The executor gets the Skill tool. Removes self-certification structurally.

options.label: Transcript skill check
options.description: On resolve, fr checks the transcript for a Skill load of each named skill in the step's window; degrades loudly on harnesses without a readable transcript. Proves loading, not following.

options.label: Prose tightening only
options.description: Sharpen fr-goal/executor prose and drop the executor's skill references it can't honor. Cheapest; this is what has already failed.

questions.question: C2 — should a plan whose only agentic phase is the walking skeleton be rejected?

options.label: Error, overridable (Recommended)
options.description: fr plan self-review errors when the skeleton is the sole agentic phase; a genuinely tiny change records a spec-scope `skeleton-override-*` justification, same escape hatch as today.

options.label: Warn only
options.description: Surface it in self-review output without failing plan-review.

options.label: Leave as is
options.description: A one-phase plan is legitimate for small fixes; rely on fr-plan being invoked (C6).

questions.question: C3 — should fr-goal hold a contract on the ORCHESTRATOR's model?

options.label: Record + warn (Recommended)
options.description: Add an `orchestrator` binding to models.yaml; fr run start/advance records the measured orchestrator model on the cursor and warns loudly (never blocks) when it differs from the binding.

options.label: Record only
options.description: Record the measured orchestrator model per step on the cursor, no binding, no warning.

options.label: Refuse on mismatch
options.description: fr run start refuses when the session model differs from the bound orchestrator model.

options.label: No contract
options.description: Orchestrator model is the operator's /model choice; only fix the executor's claimed-vs-measured recording.
